comparative_method: Only documented capabilities; uncovered intersections are research hypotheses, NOT product absence or patent novelty claims

exemplars.name: Google Earth/Maps Tiles
exemplars.scope_boundary: Does not by itself establish CoAll consent, epistemic status or project authority; no absence claim about entire product.

exemplars.name: NASA Worldview
exemplars.scope_boundary: Its purpose is Earth-observation discovery; no unverified claim about broader semantic or policy features.

exemplars.name: IIIF
exemplars.scope_boundary: Formal media APIs are not a complete CoAll authority model.

exemplars.name: OGC 3D Tiles
exemplars.scope_boundary: A spatial format cannot by itself establish truth of semantic relations.

exemplars.name: STAC
exemplars.scope_boundary: Intended for space/time assets; do not misapply the format to unrelated abstract terms.

exemplars.name: Wikidata/Wikibase
exemplars.scope_boundary: No claim that linked assertions imply execution authority.

exemplars.name: W3C PROV
exemplars.scope_boundary: Provenance expresses claimed lineage, not automatic correctness.

exemplars.name: OpenTelemetry
exemplars.scope_boundary: Operational trace data does not by itself certify reader comprehension or permissions.

exemplars.name: AWS bulkhead/cell pattern
exemplars.scope_boundary: Using multiple copies does not alone prove independent hosting or lawful federation.

candidates.name: Cross-surface meaning-preserving rendering
candidates.hypothesis: The same source-bound ID and authority envelope can survive visual, accessible and machine-only projections without semantic drift.
candidates.local_evidence: CoSysAll R0 offline 56-node/61-edge snapshot; local reciprocity bridge 17 fixture tests
candidates.critical_counterexample: An accessible/no-render projection loses qualification and presents a candidate as accepted fact.
candidates.first_test: Project one source and two edges into visual, accessible and zero-draw JSON, compare identity/claims/consent with independent checks.

candidates.name: Rights-aware interstitial multiscale retrieval
candidates.hypothesis: A semantic relation and media tile can be revealed selectively at zoom depth without private/offscreen fetch or unsupported inverse inference.
candidates.local_evidence: CoSysAll simulated semantic levels and no-render browser check; no actual IIIF/3D tile requests yet
candidates.critical_counterexample: Unpermitted source is fetched merely to decide not to draw it.
candidates.first_test: With one rights-cleared IIIF image and registered relation, compare tile fetch counts and data leakage with and without privacy-aware culling.

candidates.name: Contradiction as a research object
candidates.hypothesis: Representing unknown, inverse, contested or time-expired relations as independent challenge objects improves calibration and identifies valid follow-up experiments.
candidates.local_evidence: CoMap and CoSysAll simulated inverse/unknown lenses; bridge rejects candidate self-promotion
candidates.critical_counterexample: Graph proximity or inverse edge becomes claimed causal proof.
candidates.first_test: Introduce one false reverse link and one expiry; compare independent reviewers' fact/unknown classification versus flat graph.

candidates.name: Meaning survives original host loss
candidates.hypothesis: A separately operated cell can cold-restore one rich experience with exact source/rights/currentness, even when original host and coordinator are unavailable.
candidates.local_evidence: GitHub plus private Library copies exist; independent host cold restore not yet passed
candidates.critical_counterexample: Copies share provider, keys, DNS or currentness service and cannot operate during outage.
candidates.first_test: Restore one signed public experience from independent custody to unrelated host while primary origin and coordinator are deliberately unavailable.

candidates.name: Experience feedback without auto-authority
candidates.hypothesis: Measured comprehension/UX failures can become bounded CoEvoDelta HYPOTHESIS/PROPOSE packets without granting deployment, policy or personal authority.
candidates.local_evidence: 17 local reciprocity fixture tests and CoEvoDelta shape mapping; no external receiver
candidates.critical_counterexample: A viewer's self-reported metric can rewrite source truth or permissions.
candidates.first_test: Show a source-linked wrong claim; collect authorized anonymous usability feedback; generate candidate, reject forged permission, independently review.

candidates.name: Evolve evaluations without grading oneself
candidates.hypothesis: An evolving evaluator can be updated only after parallel scoring against an unchanged witness and an explicit actor/consent boundary.
candidates.local_evidence: CoAll architecture D1 proposed, not a demonstrated evolving metric service
candidates.critical_counterexample: Changing the evaluation metric hides a regression and labels the new version successful.
candidates.first_test: Run old/new metric side-by-side on a negative-control fixture and retain external observer's frozen result.
